items.name: cue
items.title: Cue for shadcn/ui
items.author: VLK Studio
items.description: Imperative React overlays for shadcn/ui. Create programmatic dialogs and modal flows with typed overlay handles, isolated Cue environments, stacked overlays, and one shared backdrop.
items.docs: Install the shadcn Dialog component, add showBackdrop={false} support to DialogContent, and use the generated Cue environment for typed imperative overlays. https://cue.vlkstudio.com/docs/shadcn
